name: league-schedule
description: A round robin league schedule on real dates, with home and away balanced and one calendar per team.

interface.longDescription:
Make a round robin league schedule for 3 to 24 teams on real dates, ready to print and to add to calendars. Zovo League Fixtures turns your team list into season fixtures: each pair meets once (single round robin, the default) or twice, once at each home (double round robin, home and away); no team plays twice in a round; with an odd number of teams one team has a bye each round and the byes are shared out evenly.

Home and away games are balanced: in a double round robin each team has as many home games as away games, and in a single round robin the counts differ by at most one. Runs of home or away games stay short, and the result states the longest run.

Rounds land on your play days (for example Saturdays, or Tuesdays and Thursdays), weekly or fortnightly, and skip blackout dates such as holidays or a school break. Give an end date and it tells you if the season does not fit and what to change. Add shared fields or courts with time slots (the slots rotate so the same team does not keep the first slot), or each team's home ground, and an optional kickoff time.

You get a printable schedule PDF (rounds with dates, a who-plays-whom grid, the home and away balance and a list for each team), an Excel workbook, a calendar file (ICS) with all games and one calendar file per team for Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar.

Good for recreational leagues, school and club sports, darts, pool, chess, bowling and esports leagues.

Limitations: it does not record scores, standings or tables, does not make knockout brackets or one-day tournaments, plays one round per play date, and handles up to 24 teams.
defaultPrompt: Single round robin for Lions, Tigers, Bears, Wolves, Hawks and Sharks, weekly on Saturdays from 2027-01-09
Home and away schedule for Ajax, Rovers, City, United, Athletic and Wanderers, Saturdays from 2027-01-09, skip 2027-02-13
Single round robin for Red, Blue, Green, Gold and Black, weekly on Tuesdays from 2027-03-02

positive.prompt: Make a league schedule for Lions, Tigers, Bears, Wolves, Hawks and Sharks, single round robin on Saturdays starting 2027-01-09
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_league_schedule with the 6 teams, format single, start_date 2027-01-09 and play_days Saturday. Returns 5 rounds and 15 games from 2027-01-09 to 2027-02-06; round 1 is Lions v Sharks, Tigers v Hawks and Wolves v Bears. Every pair meets once, home and away counts differ by at most one (Lions 3 home, 2 away), and the longest home or away run is 2. Offers the PDF, Excel, all-games ICS and per-team ICS downloads.

positive.description: Home and away season with blackout dates
positive.prompt: Home and away schedule for Lions, Tigers, Bears, Wolves, Hawks, Sharks, Eagles and Foxes on Saturdays from 2027-01-09, no games on 2027-02-13 or 2027-04-03
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_league_schedule with the 8 teams, format double, start_date 2027-01-09, play_days Saturday and both blackout dates. Returns 14 rounds and 56 games ending 2027-04-24; 2027-02-13 and 2027-04-03 are listed as skipped. Every team has 7 home and 7 away games, and every pair meets twice with home and away swapped.

positive.description: Odd number of teams with byes
positive.prompt: Round robin for Red, Blue, Green, Gold and Black on Tuesdays from 2027-03-02
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_league_schedule with the 5 teams, start_date 2027-03-02 and play_days Tuesday. Returns 5 rounds and 10 games from 2027-03-02 to 2027-03-30; one team has a bye each round (Red in round 1) and every team gets 1 bye, 2 home and 2 away games.

positive.prompt: Schedule 10 teams A to J on Saturdays from 2027-04-10 on Field 1 and Field 2 with kickoffs at 09:00, 10:30 and 12:00
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_league_schedule with teams A to J, start_date 2027-04-10, play_days Saturday, venues Field 1 and Field 2 and time_slots 09:00, 10:30, 12:00. Returns 9 rounds and 45 games ending 2027-06-05; round 1 starts with A v J at 09:00 on Field 1, and the 5 games of each round fit in the venue slots.

positive.description: Two play days and an end date
positive.prompt: Double round robin for Rockets, Comets, Meteors, Stars, Planets, Moons, Suns and Novas on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 7pm from 2027-01-12, done by 2027-05-31
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_league_schedule with the 8 teams, format double, start_date 2027-01-12, end_date 2027-05-31, play_days Tuesday and Thursday and kickoff_time 7pm. Returns 14 rounds and 56 games from 2027-01-12 to 2027-02-25 at 19:00, inside the end date; round 1 starts with Rockets v Novas, and every team has 7 home and 7 away games.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: single and double round robin league schedules for 3 to 24 teams on real dates with balanced home and away games, byes, play days, blackout dates, venues and time slots; printable PDF, Excel workbook, an ICS with all games and one ICS per team.

pl-PL.subtitle: Terminarze ligowe na sezon
pl-PL.description: Twórz terminarz ligi systemem każdy z każdym dla 3 do 24 drużyn, na prawdziwe daty, gotowy do druku i do kalendarza. Każda para gra raz (jedna runda) albo dwa razy, u siebie i na wyjeździe; żadna drużyna nie gra dwa razy w kolejce; przy nieparzystej liczbie drużyn jedna pauzuje w każdej kolejce, a pauzy rozkładają się równo. Mecze domowe i wyjazdowe są zrównoważone, a serie meczów u siebie lub na wyjeździe pozostają krótkie. Kolejki trafiają w wybrane dni tygodnia, co tydzień lub co dwa tygodnie, i omijają daty wyłączone (święta, ferie). Dodaj wspólne boiska z godzinami lub boisko każdej drużyny. Otrzymasz PDF do druku, skoroszyt Excel, plik kalendarza ze wszystkimi meczami i osobny plik kalendarza dla każdej drużyny. Ograniczenia: nie zapisuje wyników ani tabel i nie tworzy drabinek pucharowych.

de-DE.subtitle: Spielpläne jeder gegen jeden
de-DE.description: Erstelle einen Ligaspielplan im Modus jeder gegen jeden für 3 bis 24 Teams auf echten Terminen, druckfertig und für den Kalender. Jedes Paar spielt einmal (Einfachrunde) oder zweimal mit Hin- und Rückspiel; kein Team spielt zweimal pro Spieltag; bei ungerader Teamzahl hat in jeder Runde ein Team spielfrei, und alle bekommen gleich viele spielfreie Runden. Heim- und Auswärtsspiele sind ausgeglichen, Serien bleiben kurz. Die Spieltage liegen auf deinen Wochentagen, wöchentlich oder alle zwei Wochen, und überspringen Sperrtermine wie Ferien. Füge gemeinsame Plätze mit Anstoßzeiten oder die Heimplätze der Teams hinzu. Du erhältst ein druckbares PDF, eine Excel-Arbeitsmappe, eine Kalenderdatei mit allen Spielen und eine Kalenderdatei pro Team. Grenzen: keine Ergebnisse oder Tabellen, keine K.-o.-Turniere.

es-ES.subtitle: Calendario de partidos de liga
es-ES.description: Crea el calendario de una liga todos contra todos para 3 a 24 equipos en fechas reales, listo para imprimir y añadir al calendario. Cada pareja juega una vez (una vuelta) o dos veces, en casa y fuera; ningún equipo juega dos veces en una jornada; con un número impar de equipos uno descansa en cada jornada y todos descansan lo mismo. Los partidos en casa y fuera están equilibrados y las rachas son cortas. Las jornadas caen en tus días de juego, cada semana o cada dos semanas, y saltan las fechas bloqueadas como festivos. Añade campos compartidos con horarios o el campo de cada equipo. Obtienes un PDF imprimible, un libro de Excel, un archivo de calendario con todos los partidos y uno por equipo. Límites: no registra resultados ni clasificaciones y no crea cuadros eliminatorios.

fr-FR.subtitle: Calendriers de championnat
fr-FR.description: Créez le calendrier d'un championnat en round robin pour 3 à 24 équipes sur de vraies dates, prêt à imprimer et à ajouter à l'agenda. Chaque paire se rencontre une fois (phase simple) ou deux fois, à domicile et à l'extérieur ; aucune équipe ne joue deux fois dans une journée ; avec un nombre impair d'équipes, une équipe est exempte à chaque journée et toutes le sont autant. Les matchs à domicile et à l'extérieur sont équilibrés et les séries restent courtes. Les journées tombent sur vos jours de jeu, chaque semaine ou toutes les deux semaines, en sautant les dates bloquées comme les vacances. Ajoutez des terrains partagés avec des créneaux ou le terrain de chaque équipe. Vous obtenez un PDF imprimable, un classeur Excel, un fichier d'agenda avec tous les matchs et un par équipe. Limites : pas de résultats ni de classement, pas de tableaux à élimination directe.

ja-JP.subtitle: 総当たりリーグの日程表
ja-JP.description: 3〜24チームの総当たりリーグ日程を実際の日付で作成し、印刷やカレンダー登録に使えます。各ペアは1回（シングル）またはホームとアウェーで2回（ダブル）対戦し、同じ節に2試合するチームはありません。チーム数が奇数のときは各節で1チームが休みになり、休みの回数は全チームで同じです。ホームとアウェーの試合数は均等になり、連続も短く抑えます。節は指定した曜日に毎週または隔週で入り、祝日や休暇などの除外日を飛ばします。共有グラウンドと開始時刻、または各チームのホーム会場も指定できます。印刷用PDF、Excelブック、全試合のカレンダーファイル（ICS）、チームごとのカレンダーファイルが手に入ります。制限：スコアや順位表の管理、トーナメント表の作成はできません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Tabelas de jogos da liga
pt-BR.description: Crie a tabela de uma liga todos contra todos para 3 a 24 times em datas reais, pronta para imprimir e adicionar à agenda. Cada dupla se enfrenta uma vez (turno único) ou duas vezes, em casa e fora; nenhum time joga duas vezes na mesma rodada; com número ímpar de times, um folga em cada rodada e todos folgam o mesmo número de vezes. Jogos em casa e fora ficam equilibrados e as sequências são curtas. As rodadas caem nos seus dias de jogo, toda semana ou a cada duas semanas, e pulam datas bloqueadas como feriados. Adicione campos compartilhados com horários ou o campo de cada time. Você recebe um PDF para imprimir, uma planilha Excel, um arquivo de agenda com todos os jogos e um por time. Limites: não registra placares nem classificação e não cria chaves eliminatórias.
